================================================================================
new with an expression operand
================================================================================

package main

var a = new(42)
var b = new(int64(-64))
var c = new(x + 1)
var d = new(T{1})
var e = new(f())

            (int_literal))))))

          function: (identifier)
          arguments: (argument_list

              function: (identifier)
              arguments: (argument_list

                  operand: (int_literal)))))))))
  (var_declaration

      value: (expression_list
        (call_expression
          function: (identifier)
          arguments: (argument_list
            (binary_expression
              left: (identifier)
              right: (int_literal)))))))

================================================================================
make and new keep type operands
================================================================================

package main

var a = new(int)
var b = new(pkg.T)
var c = make([]int, 3)
var d = make(map[string]int)
var e = new(struct{ x int })

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (package_clause
    (package_identifier))
  (var_declaration
    (var_spec
      name: (identifier)
      value: (expression_list
        (call_expression
          function: (identifier)
          arguments: (argument_list
            (type_identifier))))))
  (var_declaration
    (var_spec
      name: (identifier)
      value: (expression_list
        (call_expression
          function: (identifier)
          arguments: (argument_list
            (qualified_type
              package: (package_identifier)
              name: (type_identifier)))))))
  (var_declaration
    (var_spec
      name: (identifier)
      value: (expression_list
        (call_expression
          function: (identifier)
          arguments: (argument_list
            (slice_type
              element: (type_identifier))
            (int_literal))))))
  (var_declaration
    (var_spec
      name: (identifier)
      value: (expression_list
        (call_expression
          function: (identifier)
          arguments: (argument_list
            (map_type
              key: (type_identifier)
              value: (type_identifier)))))))
  (var_declaration
    (var_spec
      name: (identifier)
      value: (expression_list
        (call_expression
          function: (identifier)
          arguments: (argument_list
            (struct_type
              (field_declaration_list
                (field_declaration
                  name: (field_identifier)
                  type: (type_identifier))))))))))

================================================================================
shadowed new called like a function
================================================================================

package main

func new(name string, rest ...int) int { return len(rest) }

var a = new("self", 1, 2)
var b = new(x.y)
var c = new(true)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  (package_clause
    (package_identifier))

        type: (type_identifier))
      (variadic_parameter_declaration
        name: (identifier)
        type: (type_identifier)))
    result: (type_identifier)
    body: (block
      (statement_list
        (return_statement
          (expression_list
            (call_expression
              function: (identifier)
              arguments: (argument_list
                (identifier))))))))
  (var_declaration
    (var_spec
      name: (identifier)
      value: (expression_list
        (call_expression
          function: (identifier)
          arguments: (argument_list
            (interpreted_string_literal
              (interpreted_string_literal_content))
            (int_literal)
            (int_literal))))))
  (var_declaration
    (var_spec
      name: (identifier)
      value: (expression_list
        (call_expression
          function: (identifier)
          arguments: (argument_list
            (qualified_type
              package: (package_identifier)
              name: (type_identifier)))))))
  (var_declaration
    (var_spec
      name: (identifier)

            (true)))))))
